verdict.rationale: A terminal emulator could plausibly ship an official control CLI, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no first-party CLI for driving iTerm2 or AI workflows. What the pack does show doesn't count here: the Python package and AppleScript support are developer building blocks for writing scripts. imgcat and it2dl are separate single-purpose utilities for showing images and downloading files, not a CLI for the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
